cutoff_policy: Latest common validated complete daily session <=2026-10-08. Never infer missing bars; record actual cutoff before run.

BASE.description: Original C13C entry and 10 percent trailing exit; benchmark, not newly approved.

C29_ATR_TRAIL.hypothesis: Volatility clustering makes a fixed percent stop inconsistent across regimes. Scale the exit to recent true range; sustained directional flow may pay for short-lived liquidity demand, without assuming it does.
C29_ATR_TRAIL.rule: Signal unchanged; ATR is Wilder20 seeded with mean first20 true ranges. Entry stop=max(0.01,roundCent(fill-3*ATR at signal close)). On each surviving complete bar: peak=max(oldPeak,high); next stop=max(oldStop,roundCent(peak-3*ATR current completed bar),0.01). Stop never decreases; daily new high or ATR never affects an earlier same-bar stop.
C29_ATR_TRAIL.why_new: Exit distance changes; C23 volatility sizing altered quantity, not trailing geometry.
C29_ATR_TRAIL.theory_parameters: 20 sessions roughly one trading month; 3ATR risk buffer is prespecified, not fitted.

C30_GAP_SHOCK.hypothesis: A downside opening discontinuity may encode adverse information rather than a temporary liquidity dip. Avoid catching that signal-day shock; remaining entry and exit remain unchanged.
C30_GAP_SHOCK.rule: Reject an otherwise valid signal at completed close t if open[t]-close[t-1] <= -1*ATR20[t-1]. ATR unavailable rejects signal. No future earnings calendar. Keep original10% ratcheting stop.
C30_GAP_SHOCK.why_new: Observed signal-day gap exclusion; distinct from C23 sector trend, sizing, SMA and C28 reentry.
C30_GAP_SHOCK.theory_parameters: One prior ATR separates ordinary overnight movement from unusually large gap by local scale; no optimization.
